EXPTRACK 1.8.0

Install EXPTRACK-1.8.0.apk over your existing app; do not uninstall.

This build adds Config > App Updates. Install it once; later app versions can be checked, downloaded and opened in Android installer from Config. Android asks for installation approval and may require Allow from this source for EXPTRACK on the first update. Existing records, login and settings remain in place.

Publish the generated android-update.json with each new versioned APK and checksum.
